timingPolicy.authority: Diagnostic only on the current non-reference machine; performance thresholds do not select or reopen a wire.
timingPolicy.cold: The first construct-free inspection in a newly started native inventory process.
timingPolicy.warm: The following four inspections in the same process; report median and p95 without flushing the OS cache.
timingPolicy.interference: Close Durin editor/test processes and avoid concurrent builds or storage-heavy work; non-exclusive runs are diagnostic only.

workloads.description: Every Git-tracked DURF/DAST v6 package and DABK v1 companion reachable from the Engine and Sandbox project mounts.
Deterministic powers-of-four size and edit distribution used only for analytic scaling and isolated Git/LFS experiments.
One atomic tightly packed authored voxel payload per VolumeTexture.
Domain-owned authored Texture2D/TextureCube source payloads; projection is not current-corpus fact.

candidates.boundary: DURF/DAST v6 with a required front Payload Directory
candidates.placement: stable sibling DABK v1 companion in Git LFS
candidates.legacyRead: the current DAST v6 reader validates the Payload Directory and resolves exact DABK v1 bytes
candidates.rollback: previous v6 package bytes and the exact companion selected by its descriptor
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: the old package remains authoritative until package replacement

candidates.boundary: a future DAST version with a changed companion index contract
candidates.placement: versioned LFS-backed companion indexed by package metadata
candidates.legacyRead: the current reader rejects the future package version before section decoding
candidates.newRead: a future reader validates the new package and companion index
candidates.rollback: retain canonical DAST v6 plus every DABK v1 byte reachable from it for an explicit migration window
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: the current v6 package remains authoritative until its replacement commits

candidates.boundary: a future DAST version naming immutable content-addressed companion bytes
candidates.publication: publish immutable companion bytes before atomic package replacement
candidates.sourceControl: .dasset ordinary Git; companion storage requires a separately qualified Git/LFS layout
candidates.legacyRead: the current reader rejects the future package version
candidates.newRead: a future reader resolves and verifies content-addressed companion identity
candidates.rollback: retain canonical DAST v6 and reachable DABK v1 bytes
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: the current package remains authoritative until replacement

candidates.boundary: a future DAST version with a package-local payload segment
candidates.sourceControl: .dasset requires an explicit ordinary-Git or LFS migration decision
candidates.legacyRead: the current reader rejects the future package version
candidates.newRead: a future reader validates bounded object and payload regions
candidates.rollback: retain canonical DAST v6 plus reconstructed DABK v1 companions
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: the complete old file remains authoritative until replacement

candidates.boundary: a future versioned footer or append-generation discovery contract
candidates.sourceControl: depends on separately qualified package and companion classification
candidates.legacyRead: the current reader rejects the future package version
candidates.newRead: a future reader discovers only a fully committed generation
candidates.rollback: the previous DAST v6/DABK v1 closure remains available
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: requires filesystem-proven atomic commit or redundant generation discovery
